question: As the Atal Pension Yojana completed 10 years in May 2025, which age group is eligible to enroll in the scheme?
solution: The correct answer is __**18-40 years**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)** is a government-backed pension scheme launched in **May 2015** by the Government of India to provide pension benefits to workers in the unorganized sector. • The eligible age group for enrolling in the scheme is **18-40 years**. Hence, individuals within this age bracket can subscribe to the scheme. • Subscribers to APY are required to contribute regularly to their pension accounts until the age of 60 years to avail of pension benefits. • The scheme is targeted at individuals who do not have any formal social security benefits, such as workers in the unorganized sector. • The pension amount provided under APY ranges between **₹1,000 to ₹5,000** per month, depending on the contribution made during the subscription period.
